people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: She said to Elijah, “What have I to do with you, you man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to memory, and to kill my son!”
translations.bsb: “O man of God,” said the woman to Elijah, “what have you done to me? Have you come to remind me of my iniquity and cause the death of my son?”
translations.kjv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? art thou come unto me to call ➔ my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
translations.asv: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with thee, O thou man of God? thou art come unto me to bring my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son!
